definitions.explanation: Miso made by combining two or more types (usually white and red, or rice and barley miso). Balances the flavors of each kind and is widely sold as a general-purpose miso.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{味噌汁|みそしる}は{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}で{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made today's miso soup with blended miso.

examples.japanese: {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}はクセが{少|すく}なくて{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: Blended miso has less of a strong flavor and is easy to use.

examples.japanese: {白味噌|しろみそ}と{赤味噌|あかみそ}を{半分|はんぶん}ずつ{混|ま}ぜて{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}にした。
examples.english: I mixed white and red miso in equal parts to make blended miso.

notes:
The verb stem {合|あ}わせ ("combining") + {味噌|みそ}. Most miso sold in supermarkets is actually {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}, since pure single-type miso has a stronger character that not everyone prefers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}{仕立|じた}て: prepared with blended miso (on menus)
- {自家製|じかせい}{合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ}: homemade blended miso

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {白味噌|しろみそ}: white miso — milder and sweeter
- {赤味噌|あかみそ}: red miso — saltier and stronger; aged longer
